'''Hez''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="TCWn" />

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he served in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], a unit with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] and later the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. Hez assisted Skywalker and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in recovering a kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|Huttlet]]. Hez and at least three members of his [[Hez's squad|squad]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when he fell to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] fire while defending the entrance to the [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] where the Huttlet was being held.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Hez stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hez first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
